observations: Photos 0, 1 and 2: one removed automatic transmission with a transfer case bolted to the rear, lying on bare earth in a parts yard.
The bell housing, cooler lines, wiring harness and a front output shaft on the transfer case are visible, consistent with a four wheel drive gearbox.
The casing is covered in dust, grime and oil residue; a yellow paint dot is on the bell housing.
No brand, model, part number or transmission ID tag can be read in any photo.
Other gearboxes and engines lie around it, partly under a tarpaulin; 'Posted on Jiji' and a dealer watermark are on all photos.
Nothing shows the gearbox fitted, running, or the fluid condition.

identity.kind: used 4WD automatic gearbox with transfer case

claims.evidence: No tag, part number or casting mark readable in any photo; the fitment comes only from the seller's words.
Origin cannot be shown by photos of the part.
Photos 0, 1 and 2 show a dirty, grimy, oil stained used unit lying on the ground.
Internal history cannot be seen; no seal marks are shown close up.
The unit is out of a vehicle; no clip of it working or of the donor vehicle driving.
No receipt or warranty document shown.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be for a Ford Expedition V8 4WD, which sets the price and whether it fits a buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the transmission ID tag or stamped part number on the casing, and the transfer case tag.
risks.if_unproven: as an unidentified gearbox of unknown fitment; no fitment specific price

risks.risk: Internal wear or failure: slipping, burnt clutches, failed solenoids or a damaged transfer case.
risks.proof: A photo of the fluid on the dipstick or from the drain, and a clip of the donor vehicle driving and shifting with this gearbox fitted.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, a rebuild core

risks.risk: Missing or damaged parts: torque converter, sensors, harness plugs, cracked casing.
risks.proof: Close-ups of the bell housing with the torque converter in place and of both sides of the casing.
risks.if_unproven: as missing the torque converter and with damaged sensors

proof_requests: Sharp close-up of the transmission ID tag or part number on the casing, and of the transfer case tag, with a handwritten code with today's date in shot.
Clip of the donor vehicle driving and shifting through the gears, or a bench test clip.
Photo of the transmission fluid colour and smell check from the drain or dipstick.
Close-up of the bell housing showing the torque converter and of both sides of the casing for cracks.
response.reason: It is clearly a used 4WD automatic gearbox with transfer case, but which vehicle it fits, the thing that sets its price, is unreadable in every photo and comes only from the seller's words. The 'like new' claim is contradicted by the dirty, used condition shown.
